title: Up to the castle
steps: We walk up the road to the castle together. The windows are lit. The great doors wait for us.
You learned a lot today. You wrote a list of instructions. This is a program. You met objects and their actions, the methods.
You wrote notes, the comments. You told methods how much, with arguments. You put words in quotes, the strings. You picked up a wand. You cast a spell.

Remember that the wand is only lent. Our teacher, Ilda, waits for us inside. We must go to the wand bank, a counter inside the castle run by the pupils' parents, to borrow a school wand for you. Then you can give my spare wand back to me. The real castle comes next!
